description.value: Cortes Natural Food Co-op is a community-owned cooperative on Cortes Island, one of BC's more remote Gulf Islands accessible only by ferry, and the island's primary grocery hub. Founded in 2004 with over 1,000 member-owners, it runs a full natural food market stocked with local and organic produce, bulk foods, meat, seafood, and household staples alongside an in-house bakery and café. For cyclists touring Cortes, it is the essential resupply stop on the island.

address.value: 800 Sutil Point Rd, Mansons Landing, BC V0P 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an actively operating community food cooperative with blog posts and a hiring notice dated March 2026, establishing it as currently open. Phone number (250-935-8577) and website URL match OSM exactly; the website's 'Find Us' section provides a more complete physical address (800 Sutil Point Rd) than the OSM record. No bike parking or water refill facilities are mentioned anywhere on the website, but grocery inventory, café hot food, and free Wi-Fi are clearly documented.
concerns: OSM address lacks street number; website 'Find Us' section shows physical address as '800 Sutil Point Rd'.
OSM name 'Cortes Natural Food Coop' omits the hyphen used consistently on the website ('Cortes Natural Food Co-op').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible grocery cooperative confirmed open as of March 2026. The primary grocery stop on Cortes Island, making it an essential resource for any cyclist touring the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free Wi-Fi available for members or with a food purchase (password at the till). ATM available outside the building. Accepts Canadian cash, Interac/debit, Visa, Mastercard, and American cash.

Basic groceries.detail: Store stocked with fresh + frozen meat and seafood, dairy + dairy alternatives, seasonal produce, bulk nuts, grains, legumes, coffee, tea, spices, snacks, household staples, wellness products, and supplements

Hot food.detail: Café serves pizza, soup, baguette sandwiches, wraps, and espresso drinks; website states many items including pizza and soup are made in-house

wow_evidence: community-owned cooperative...over 1,000 member-owners...island's primary grocery hub
